inputs.text: Black spade marks ONLY on him; red diamond marks ONLY on her; no letters or text anywhere. Stained glass style depiction of a first-deal meeting at a giant card table, intricate details, vibrant colors: the spade king with short silver-grey hair, black spade crown and black-silver armor faces the diamond queen with very long red-orange hair, diamond tiara and white gown across green felt scattered with oversized playing cards, both her arms visible with defined hands resting near the table, both his hands on the table edge, tavern hall with hanging lanterns and timber beams, every element cut colored glass with black lead came in deep reds, greens, golds and blues, glowing with its own light
